title: GTP: Introduce heuristic dissector list to handle PDU dissection
description:
GTP PDU dissection already has a configuration-option "heuristic".
The implementation of this option however is rather static and limited.

This commit refactors the current code for heuristic dissection and uses
the heuristic-dissector-list concept. The set of accepted protocols has
remained the same: ipv4, ipv6 and a small subset of ethernet protocols.

To achieve this for IP, the existing heuristic dissector has been reused
and registered against the new list.

To handle ethernet, the same heuristic code that is currently
implemented is refactored into a heuristic dissector function.
This is then improved upon in a second commit by also allowing
a set of vlan tags and PPPoE data/control protocols to be detected.

In another MR I will introduce a heuristic dissector for NSH, which also
is a protocol that can be embedded in GTP PDU as per BBF TR-459i2.

Hello,

I am not sure if this is the right place to ask this question, but the question is related very closely to this new feature - so I will ask here first and then open a separate ticket if needed.

I have a use-case where I need to do custom dissection of the GTPv1 T-PDU. I am initially trying to write the heuristic dissector in LUA for proof of concept. However, when I try to load it, I get the error:
![image](/uploads/a8f5c03959bea806e8945f62fd24e452/image.png).

Also, I double-checked in Wireshark - View > Internals > Dissector Tables, I don't see gtp.tpdu in the Heuristics Table (or others).
![image](/uploads/deba871d99522c7698d93d5be831c182/image.png)

I just wanted to check if I am approaching this incorrectly, or something is actually wrong. 

What is interesting is that IP over GTP is getting dissected correctly, which means that the new approach seems to work, obviously. 

Thanks,
Abhik

I suggest you start by double checking the version of the wireshark you are running.

When I check the dissector-tables as you described, I do see the new heuristic dissector table in the list:

![image](/uploads/48546fd9863d998f14c3d3733b1b1814/image.png)

Before this MR there was already support for IP as PDU-type, so that doesn't really tell us anything.
@jpeeraer , my bad indeed. I am using the latest stable release (4.4.3), but I forgot that new features don't go into the stable branches. Really sorry for the noise :disappointed:

Two improvements to the heuristic have been made:
- allow a set of vlan-tags to be present
- recognize PPPoE data/control protocols
